checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One silent 9:16 reel ~10 s with no added text
must.why: The reel is 10 s and has no text. The file reports a sound track with peak 0 dB, so it is probably not silent.

must.item: All five photos appear in requested order
must.why: The sampled frames show storefront, latte, barista and interior, but the pastries photo was not seen. The barista is a redrawn scene, not the original photo.

must.item: Landscape storefront, barista and interior retain complete boundaries
must.why: The storefront and interior are fitted, but the barista frame is a full-bleed AI re-render of a different composition.

must.item: Square latte and vertical pastries remain fully visible without cropping
must.why: The latte is extended to fill the whole 9:16 frame with invented chairs and legs, and has glass-like artefacts. Pastries were not visible in the sampled frames.

must.item: Every foreground photo keeps original proportions
must.why: The storefront looks proportionate. The latte and barista are reimagined or extended, so they do not match the originals.

must.item: Unused canvas filled with soft blurred background
must.why: The storefront and interior have blurred bands. The latte and barista frames have no blurred bands, because the AI filled the whole frame with content.

faults.what: The AI video redraws the photos, so the barista and latte are not the user's original images. The barista is a new composition with a seated pose, and the latte is outpainted to full frame.
The latte frame has glassy, transparent overlay artefacts on the table and saucer.
The storefront blurred bands look like odd ghosted copies of the cup and table, not a clean soft blur.
The clip has an audio track at peak 0 dB despite the request for no music.
The five separate frames have inconsistent fit. The storefront is shrunk to a small inset in a blurred halo, and the latte and barista are full-bleed or loosely edited.

summary: The 10 s vertical reel is an AI re-render that reorders the photos only roughly: the latte and barista are reimagined or cropped, the blurred-fit approach holds for only some frames, and an audio track is present, so it fails the keep-whole-photos requirement.
